headline: Is Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Below Fair Value After Its Housing Bet?
summary: Berkshire Hathaway has added 80.1% over the past 5 years, yet the stock still screens as undervalued on both its intrinsic value estimate and earnings based multiples. That combination is drawing attention as Greg Abel starts to put the company’s very large cash pile to work in housing, AI related stakes and share buybacks. headline: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Makes Greg Abel’s First Big CEO Deal In Housing
summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK.A) agreed to acquire Taylor Morrison Home Corp., marking Greg Abel's first major deal as CEO. The transaction significantly expands Berkshire's presence in U.S. housing, including the active-adult segment. The move aligns with Berkshire's wider push to support homeownership accessibility across its portfolio companies.
